generation.scope: Every window in the established central open of the fully asymmetric fifteen-dimensional component is recovered from a smooth plane quartic and four semistable rank-four bundles. The marked central pencil is classified by the curve and the bundles up to common twist. For arbitrary admissible curve input a finite criterion uses paths through degree 36 and Koszul complexes through degree 16, even when only the first two central parameters lift centrally.

open_mathematics: Extend the central curve realization past the known open, and study the remaining asymmetric candidates via linked K3 pencils. Locate the rank-two representations in the unresolved central boundary.
